_doc: What a trial's safety collection did NOT ascertain (harness/collection_scope.py): NOT_SYSTEMATICALLY_COLLECTED, distinct from not reported / not retrieved / zero. Each declaration carries held witnesses of the collection rule.

semaglutide-obesity-mace.collected: serious adverse events; adverse events leading to permanent discontinuation irrespective of seriousness; prespecified adverse events of special interest
semaglutide-obesity-mace.not_collected: non-serious adverse events that met none of those criteria -- so 'any GI adverse event' was never ascertained
semaglutide-obesity-mace.why: never a sum of the serious-GI (342 vs 323) and GI-discontinuation (880 vs 172) rows: a patient can be in both, and a non-serious GI event that did not lead to discontinuation was never recorded

collection_rule_witnesses.span: the only adverse events systematically recorded and reported were serious adverse events, adverse events leading to discontinuation of the trial product irrespective of seriousness, and adverse events of prespecified special interest irrespective of seriousness.
Nonserious AEs not fulfilling any of the listed criteria were not systematically collected.
